_meta.purpose: Selection rules for the link-intersect engine. The single source of truth for HOW an outreach target is chosen. Tune here, not in code/prose.

hard_filters._comment: A domain must pass ALL of these to survive, applied after intersect + subtract.

intersect._comment: Core signal: how many distinct competitors link to this domain. >=2 means it already references multiple players in your category.

platform_denylist._comment: Generic platforms where a 'link' is a hosted page/profile/footer, not an editorial opportunity. Never outreach targets. Trim or extend for your niche.

category_denylist._comment: Domain CATEGORIES that are dofollow but not contribute-able (competitor job posts, hosted podcasts).

spam_patterns._comment: Belt-and-suspenders on top of Ahrefs is_spam. Drop on regex match of the root domain (PBN / paid-link footprints).

link_type_targets._comment: The contribute-able opportunity types. Step 5 tags each survivor by reading its linking page; this drives the pitch angle. 'other' is held for manual review.
link_type_targets.listicle: best-X / top-tools / alternatives-to roundup. Pitch: add us to the list.
link_type_targets.resource_page: curated links / 'tools we use'. Pitch: include us as a resource.
link_type_targets.editorial_media: news / analysis article. Pitch: contributor article or expert quote.
link_type_targets.newsletter: they covered a competitor. Pitch: brief the author or buy a slot.
link_type_targets.directory: SaaS / startup database listing. Pitch: claim or request a listing.
link_type_targets.dev_blog: engineering blog mentioning a category tool. Pitch: technical guest post.
link_type_targets.podcast: actual show (not a hosting platform). Pitch: guest spot.

topical_keywords._comment: Used for the topical-relevance score and the overlap=1 exception. Replace with terms on-theme for YOUR category.

scoring_weights._comment: Final rank = weighted sum of normalized components. Tune toward authority vs topical fit vs ease.
